instruction.text: Which pictures show pushing and which pictures show pulling? Drag each picture to the correct group.
Which object will need a harder push to move?

feedback.end: The giant rock is larger and heavier than the cardboard box, so it will be much harder for someone to push it forwards.

instruction.text: Which object will need a stronger pull to move?

feedback.end: The bed is much larger and heavier than the rocking chair, so it will be much harder for someone to pull it away from the corner of the room.

instruction.text: Which object will be easier to push?

feedback.end: The soft pillow is much lighter than the leather sofa, so it will be much easier for someone to move it by pushing it.

instruction.text: Which object will be easier to pull?

feedback.end: The purple suitcase will be easier to pull because it is smaller and it has wheels to roll on.
